english: Walking downhill this way is a standard optimization method. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1847 Augustin-Louis Cauchy, wanting to solve the equations of an orbit, wrote them as a sum of squares and proposed stepping against its gradient. <bookmark mark='b'/> Written today: the next point is the current one, minus a step size eta times the gradient there. <bookmark mark='c'/> How large a step, and how fast it arrives, depends on the curvature, which comes in chapter fourteen and again in Part 11.
chinese: 这样一路走下坡，是一种标准的优化方法。<bookmark mark='a'/>1847年，奥古斯丁–路易·柯西想解出一条轨道的方程组，就把它们写成一个平方和，并提出逆着它的梯度一步步走。<bookmark mark='b'/>用今天的写法：下一个点，等于当前的点，减去步长η乘以那里的梯度。<bookmark mark='c'/>步子该多大，多快能走到，取决于曲率，这要到第14章，再到第11部分去讲。
